' into fragments; every fragment must be a substring of the cited document's text after normalization: Unicode format characters (category Cf, e.g. zero-width spaces) removed and every run of whitespace (including line breaks and NBSP) replaced by one space, the same normalization applied to the fragment. For a zip the text is that of the named member; the hash is the zip's.
